reference.name: CharacterGen 3D Stage
reference.policy: behavioral/function comparison only; no vendor dependency and no source-text copying into RealSaS

required_before_promotion: same-family downstream Geppetto non-inferiority or improvement
same-family downstream Arachne non-inferiority or improvement

functional_comparison.reference_behavior: flatten per-view camera condition (c2w_cond) and map it into the image-token feature dimension
functional_comparison.realsas_current: OrthographicCameraV2 + q_domain_v2 use exact cameras only to analytically construct/project q candidates
functional_comparison.gap: camera direction/frame is not encoded into learned image tokens
functional_comparison.cleanroom_form: exact-camera embedding from origin/right/up/forward/half_extent; no categorical absolute view ID

functional_comparison.reference_behavior: extract DINOv2 local tokens and condition the DINO transformer through camera-dependent modulation
functional_comparison.realsas_current: QDescriptorSamplerV2 samples frozen foundation maps plus an RGB native pyramid at already-projected candidate locations
functional_comparison.gap: features become multi-view evidence only after candidate projection; no globally camera-aware token bank exists
functional_comparison.cleanroom_form: first arm keeps foundation encoder frozen and adds exact-camera conditioning after feature extraction; encoder-internal modulation is a challenger only if late conditioning shows a ceiling

functional_comparison.reference_behavior: create persistent learnable scene-query tokens arranged as three orthogonal latent planes
functional_comparison.realsas_current: no persistent shared scene latent; each q/depth candidate is constructed from an anchor ray
functional_comparison.gap: the representation is anchor-oriented rather than globally queryable in 3D
functional_comparison.cleanroom_form: learnable XY/XZ/YZ scene-query tokens with explicit canonical object-frame coordinates

functional_comparison.reference_behavior: concatenate all view image tokens; let scene tokens repeatedly self-attend and cross-attend to all view tokens; output one shared 3D scene representation
functional_comparison.realsas_current: QEvidenceEncoderV2 reasons over only eight view samples for one q/depth candidate, pools them, then EvidenceFieldV2 reasons along that anchor ray and neighboring anchor rays
functional_comparison.gap: no global all-image-to-scene fusion stage exists before geometric querying; non-overlapping views can only interact if the same anchor-generated candidate projects into them
functional_comparison.cleanroom_form: scene-query Transformer decoder: scene tokens query flattened camera-aware multi-view image tokens

functional_comparison.reference_behavior: spatially upsample the fused triplane latent before geometry querying
functional_comparison.realsas_current: native image detail exists, but there is no spatial 3D latent to upsample
functional_comparison.gap: shared field resolution/detail tradeoff is absent
functional_comparison.cleanroom_form: single learned 2x triplane upsample; further detail belongs to a later local refinement arm

functional_comparison.reference_behavior: project arbitrary 3D points to XY/XZ/YZ planes, bilinearly sample three latent features, concatenate/reduce them and decode a continuous geometry field
functional_comparison.realsas_current: EvidenceFieldV2 is defined only on the discrete q/depth hypothesis lattice
functional_comparison.gap: current IRIS cannot ask a continuous shared scene representation 'what geometry exists at P?' independently of anchor construction

functional_comparison.reference_behavior: decode queried latent features into signed-distance geometry plus appearance features
functional_comparison.realsas_current: DepthSupportUncertaintyHeadV2 emits depth/support/uncertainty for extracted ray modes
functional_comparison.gap: geometry authority is per-ray depth rather than a scene field
functional_comparison.cleanroom_form: predict unsigned surface distance plus log uncertainty; do not predict RGB/material features. SDF sign is not required by RiggingSurfaceIR and is not assumed until experimentally justified

functional_comparison.reference_behavior: convert the signed field into a closed triangle mesh
functional_comparison.realsas_current: RiggingSurfaceIR needs surface nodes P, optional derived normals and relations; it does not require a closed 3D mesh
functional_comparison.gap: none required for current downstream contract
functional_comparison.reason: mesh extraction solves CharacterGen's graphics/export objective, not RealSaS's minimum mechanical substrate objective

functional_comparison.reference_behavior: rasterize mesh, synthesize RGB/normal/depth, unwrap UV and export textured OBJ
functional_comparison.realsas_current: direction-local artwork and editable 2D mesh are downstream compiler concerns

functional_comparison.reference_behavior: single arbitrary image to canonical multi-view A-pose images
functional_comparison.realsas_current: shipping contract already supplies ordered canonical/neutral eight-view turnaround
functional_comparison.gap: none for the current product contract

cleanroom_v1_minimum.input: 8 RGB observations + exact ordered orthographic cameras
reuse_without_modification: existing native RGB feature path where memory permits

hypothesis: The missing capability in the incumbent IRIS is not XYZ prediction or mesh extraction; it is a globally queryable, camera-aware multi-view scene field that lets non-overlapping views contribute to one shared 3D representation before surface extraction.
